reason: At a regular local surface point the dual of any finite module has depth at least two, so its double dual is maximal Cohen–Macaulay and free by Auslander–Buchsbaum. Height-one localizations are DVRs, giving local freeness there. The codimension-one intersection property of normal domains gives the generic-vector extension, and codimension-one agreement yields the determinant identity after double dualizing.
